title: Remove Duplicates
description:
Given a sorted array of $n$ integers, remove the duplicates in-place and print the unique elements.

The array is sorted in non-decreasing order.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^5$) — the size of the array.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$) in non-decreasing order.
outputFormat:
On the first line, print $k$ — the number of unique elements.

On the second line, print the $k$ unique elements in their original order, separated by spaces.
